title: Conditional zone move
statement: For a zone configuration with ℓ zones, the zone-move operation leaves the configuration unchanged if there are no zones. Otherwise, when moving right it performs the rightward move if the first left-zone word can accommodate one more entry, and when moving left it performs the leftward move if the first right-zone word can accommodate one more entry; if the relevant word cannot accommodate that entry, it leaves the configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean direction, with true denoting right and false denoting left
The zone configuration has that number of zones
caveat: The formal statement refers to rightward and leftward move operations whose definitions are not included, so their precise effects cannot be rendered.
